headline: New defenders, new investigators and new suspects. Żurek and Giertych speak out on Zondacrypto | Niezalezna.pl
summary: Roman Giertych said he has been defender of Zondacrypto's president since May, and Żurek also commented on the case. The input describes new defenders, investigators and suspects.
why: Zondacrypto is a crypto trading platform, and legal proceedings against exchange operators affect investor confidence and regulatory scrutiny of the sector.
